hits.hook: TheHackersNews — Citrix NetScaler: two unpatched RCE 0-days in the wild
hits.draft_en:
Two unpatched RCEs. Already in the wild. No patch yet.

watchTowr says Citrix NetScaler is under active exploitation for two remote code execution zero-days — and at WARNING time Citrix had not confirmed, shipped a fix, listed affected versions, or published IoCs.

If you run NetScaler ADC / Gateway on the edge:
→ assume “internet-facing + unpatched appliance” is a paging event
→ inventory every NetScaler (prod, DR, forgotten DMZ boxes)
→ tighten management-plane exposure now; don’t wait for the PDF
→ pre-stage capture (PCAPs, auth logs) so IoCs aren’t a scavenger hunt later
→ treat edge ADC as crown-jewel IR, not “just a load balancer”

Unconfirmed ≠ safe. Active exploit traffic is the confirmation.

bookmark this. steal the stack. pin the NetScaler 0-day freeze checklist.
hits.video_tip: 22–30s: red ‘UNPATCHED’ stamp → NetScaler edge diagram → ‘no IoCs yet’ beat → inventory CTA.

hits.draft_en:
From “unpatched warning” to “confirmed + patched” in hours.

Citrix confirmed two NetScaler flaws were exploited on unmitigated deployments and shipped fixes — CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 — inside an advisory covering eight CVEs on ADC/Gateway.

Same-day defender moves:
→ patch cadence that absorbs a Sunday advisory (owners, change window, rollback)
→ diff WARNING → BREAKING: what changed (CVEs, mitigations, blast radius)
→ hunt pre-patch windows on unmitigated appliances
→ remember edge appliances get chained; don’t stop at “we clicked Update”

Speed of exploit → speed of confirm → speed of your change ticket.

bookmark this. steal the stack. pin the WARNING→PATCH same-day drill.

hits.draft_en:
Security people cross-train on weird surfaces. This one has clear coat.

@SwiftOnSecurity’s PROJECT CAR: a 2012 Honda Accord as the chemical decon / paint-correction / ceramic-coat training platform — harsh chemicals welcome because some panels need a body-shop respray anyway.

Oddly useful ops metaphor:
→ keep a disposable lab bench for destructive tests (malware detonation ↔ paint chemicals)
→ practice irreversible procedures where failure is cheap
→ document the “harsh stuff” runbook before you touch the production asset
→ family hand-me-down hardware still deserves a change window

Train where scrapes are allowed. Ship where they aren’t.

virals.text:
AI stocks are massively outperforming the global market:

The Bloomberg Global AI index has surged +118% since the start of 2024, to near its all-time high.

At the same time, the MSCI World Index has risen +57%, underperforming by 61 percentage points.

By comparison, the MSCI Emerging Market Index has soared +70% over this period, to near its all-time high.

Since the start of 2024, AI stocks have generated an average annualized return of +38%, double the +19% annualized return of global equities over the same period.

The AI index has also significantly outperformed emerging markets, which have delivered an annualized return of +23%.

AI stocks have left the rest of the global market far behind.
